# netactuate_firewall_set_vm (Resource)

Manages a Firewall Set VM.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_firewall_set_vm" "example" {
  firewall_set_id = 12345
  mbpkgid         = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `firewall_set_id` (Number) The ID of the firewall set to attach the VM to
- `mbpkgid` (Number) The VM package ID to attach

### Optional

- `interface_id` (Number) The network interface ID (default 0)
- `set_priority` (Number) Priority of the firewall set for this VM (default 0)

### Read-Only

- `hostname` (String) Hostname of the attached VM
- `iata_code` (String) IATA code of the VM location
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `location` (String) Location name of the VM

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_firewall_set_vm.example 12345
```
